resources.string: Revokes TrainPilot Google permissions and disconnects the account. Cloud data is not deleted.
Deletes backups and workout photos in TrainPilot app-data storage only. Other Drive files are unaffected. Remote deletion cannot be undone.
Deletes only workout calendars owned by this account and managed by TrainPilot. Other calendars are unaffected. Deletion cannot be undone.
Local history and photos are retained. Cloud sync pauses until you explicitly start sync again. Partial remote deletion cannot be rolled back.
At least %1$d remote operations confirmed. The operation is incomplete; the last remote request may have an uncertain result. Check the account. Open and confirm again to retry.
Operation failed. Check the account, permissions and workout/sync status. Retrying requires separate confirmation.
